supporting_observations.claim: The svc-ledger failures began at 13:31, immediately after the scheduled 13:30 password rotation, and recur at roughly one-minute intervals through 13:46, consistent with the inventoried LedgerSync job re-authenticating every minute while still using stale credentials.
The failed logons identify FILE-SUN-01 as the workstation and show the same source address and process ID across the failures, rather than showing an apparent remote or interactive logon.
The domain authentication records report bad-password or pre-authentication failures for svc-ledger, consistent with stale credentials after the scheduled rotation.
A 14:00 explicit-credentials event targets svc-ledger on FILE-SUN-01 under SYSTEM; it does not establish whether authentication succeeded or whether the job configuration was updated.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not cover the remainder of the requested window after 14:00, so activity from 14:00 to 14:20 cannot be assessed.
The authentication events identify LSASS as the process for the failed logons, but do not identify the LedgerSync executable or its credential configuration.
The supplied records do not show a successful svc-ledger authentication or confirm when the scheduled job was updated.
claims_not_established: The exact time the svc-ledger password was changed and the time the LedgerSync job was updated.
Whether any further svc-ledger authentication activity occurred between 14:00 and 14:20.
